name: Castorcito webform
description: Sub-module of Castorcito that adds a 'webform' cfield type to embed a Webform inside a Castorcito component.
project_description: Castorcito webform is a sub-module of Castorcito that adds a new cfield type ('webform') allowing you to embed Webform forms within Castorcito components. The cfield is a CastorcitoComponentField plugin (Webform) built on ConfigurableComponentFieldBase; its model stores the selected webform id, and its SDC renders the referenced webform with Twig Tweak's drupal_entity. It depends on the contributed Webform module. An update hook removes an obsolete url_autocomplete setting from existing webform cfields.
